text:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  rw [lt_iff_le_and_lt, le_antisymm]
  rcases hxy with (h1 : x ≤ y) (h2 : x < y)
  have h3 : y ≥ 0 := Ici_subset_univ.2 h1
  have h4 : x ≥ 0 := Ici_subset_univ.2 h1
  have h5 : y > 0 := lt_iff_le_and_lt.2 h2
  have h6 : x > 0 := lt_iff_le_and_lt.2 (le_of_lt h2)
  have h7 : √y - √x < (√y - √x) * (y - x) / (2 * √x) :=
    calc
      √y - √x < (√y - √x) * (y - x) / (2 * √x) :=
        mul_lt_mul_right (lt_trans h6 h5) (inv_pos (mul_pos (gt_zero_of_gt h6) (gt_zero_of_gt h5)))
  have h8 : (√y - √x) * (y - x) / (2 * √x) < √y - √x :=
    calc
      (√y - √x) * (y - x) / (2 * √x) < √y - √x :=
        mul_lt_mul_left (lt_trans h5 h2) (inv_pos (mul_pos (gt_zero_of_gt h6) (gt_zero_of_gt h5)))
  exact lt_trans h7 h8
